mapper.insert: insert into a2a_result_idempotency_claims(tenant_id,idempotency_key,a2a_request_id,a2a_result_id,acceptance_attempt_id,result_fingerprint,claimed_at) values(#{claim.tenantId},#{claim.idempotencyKey},#{claim.requestId},#{claim.resultId},#{claim.acceptanceAttemptId},#{claim.resultFingerprint},coalesce(#{claim.claimedAt},now())) on conflict(tenant_id,idempotency_key) do nothing
mapper.select: select * from a2a_result_idempotency_claims where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and idempotency_key=#{idempotencyKey}
